`final class MsdfBounds`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.font.impl.msdf` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [MsdfBounds.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/font/impl/msdf/MsdfBounds.java)

A rectangle of an MSDF glyph, either on 1 of the em with Y up or in pixels of the atlas.

## Description

[`MsdfGlyph`](/reference/text/msdfglyph/) holds two: its plane bounds around the origin of the glyph, and its atlas bounds in the image.

- [MSDF text](/use/in-depth/msdf-text/)
